create_RotatedBoxes: create a RotatedBoxes object from a Nx5 tensor with (x_center, y_center, width, height, angle) format
compute_pairwise_iou_rotated: compute pairwise IoU matrix between two sets of rotated boxes in (x_center, y_center, width, height, angle) format
clip_rotated_boxes: clip near-horizontal rotated boxes to image boundaries while preserving angle and dimensions
scale_rotated_boxes: scale rotated boxes with independent x and y factors approximating parallelogram back to rotated rectangle
cat_rotated_boxes: concatenate a list of RotatedBoxes objects into a single RotatedBoxes without shared storage
